hygiene_rules: State the level and weight of every modular form.

questions.sentence: For which primes l and moduli does p(l^k n + b) vanish mod l^k for all n?
answer_shapes: a complete list of (l, b) for k = 1 beyond Ramanujan's 5, 7, 11
a criterion in terms of the eta-quotient's level
a complete list of (l, b) for k >= 2
questions.why: Ramanujan-type congruences are classified for k = 1; the higher-power picture is not.

conjectures.statement: Every Ramanujan-type congruence mod l^2 for l >= 13 lifts a congruence mod l.
conjectures.tie: If true, A3 reduces to the A1 list plus a lifting test for each entry.
